name: Am Haus zur Mühle
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Am Haus zur Mühle enjoys a peaceful location in Thiersee, Tyrol. Originating from a former mill, the property combines historic building fabric with modern comfort. Guests have access to a garden and private parking. Several hiking and cycling trails are directly accessible from the apartment. In winter, a ski bus transports guests conveniently to the ski resorts of the Alpbach Valley. The accommodation also features a ski storage room and complimentary Wi-Fi.
